enemy._comment: Enemy ship (r41, #255 basics; reactor_core enemy.rs, sources there): an abstract ship with no model and no flight (the dev area has no space flight). shield is the same shield model as ours with its own numbers (upkeep is unused here: the enemy runs at full power). hull is its hull (points, a shot past the shield takes it down). shot_damage is our GN-01 shot. The turret fires every fire_every_s (Barotrauma Turret.cs reload as a timer), the first shot first_shot_s after the ambush starts; light_share of its shots are the light hit, the rest heavy (the hits block).
